reason: FImageUtils compressed output in the diagnostic .png-named frames has JPEG signature FFD8FFE0. FFmpeg's extension-selected PNG decoder rejected it. No raw/uncompressed frame format was used.
resolution: Exporter now reads the actual format with Pillow and explicitly selects mjpeg or png decoder. The zero-packet temporary MP4 is removed only after exact path and small size verification; original compressed frames retained until final decode succeeds.
